brand.headline: Ahantu hamwe h'inyandiko z'ikoperative yanyu.
brand.body: Abanyamuryango, amafaranga, ibicuruzwa, kugurisha, inama n'inyandiko — byose hamwe, mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa mu Cyongereza, bikorwa n'abakozi b'ibiro.

forgot.title: Hindura ijambobanga
forgot.description: Tanga aderesi ya imeyili iri kuri konti yawe, tukoherereze umurongo wo guhindura.
forgot.sentBody: Niba iyo aderesi ifite konti, umurongo wo guhindura uraza. Ukoreshwa rimwe gusa kandi urangira mu isaha imwe.

reset.title: Hitamo ijambobanga rishya
reset.description: Hitamo iryo wibuka. Uzasohoka ku bindi bikoresho byose.

validation.email: Andika aderesi ya imeyili iri kuri konti yawe.
